messages:
ryan: FYI scheduled promotion tonight 23:30 UTC for ai-worker chart v1.9.0 -> prod. Staging canary emitted a PV bind failure and a values change for pvc.template. tagging @jess @marta.

jess: paste the diff?

ryan:```diff
- pvc:
-  template: worker-{{ .Values.team }}
+ pvc:
+  template: worker-{{ .Values.team }}-data
```

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: staging canary 2/8. 1 pod failed: pvc claim not found (MountVolume.MountDevice failed).

marta: that's unsafe for prod. If claim name changes we lose existing bindings. Propose PAUSE and pin back to v1.8.6. Also need migration job to reconcile claims.

liam: +1. If we pin, ensure image digest pinned in helm values (no floating tag). I'll prep the rollback commands.

jess: quick commands for pin:
```bash
helm upgrade ai-worker charts/ai-worker --version 1.8.6 \
  --set image.tag=sha256:feedface --namespace prod --atomic --wait 
kubectl annotate deploy/ai-worker release-pin=1.8.6 -n prod || true
```

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: manual hold requested by ryan. canary aborted at 2/8. scheduling rollback to previous in staging in 3m.

ryan: I'll open RT-9001 to track migration and compatibility testing. Will notify support and pause external release notes until resolved.

marta: plan: 1) pin to 1.8.6, 2) run migration job in dev/staging to rename claims while preserving PVs, 3) add backward-compatible templating to chart (support both patterns) for a patch, 4) re-run canary.

liam: PR opened for pin: https://git.redwood/infra/helm-charts/pulls/4701. Includes pinned digest and rollback runbook.

ryan: thanks all. will post migration results here when ready. :white_check_mark:
